raktapittena duṣṭamalābughaṭikābhyāṃ na nirharedagnisaṃyogādvātakaphābhyāṃ ca duṣṭaṃ nirharet |
gātraṃ badhvoparidṛḍhaṃ rajjvā paṭṭena vā samam |
bahavo hi raktāvasecanopāyāḥ prāgabhihitāsteṣāmanyeṣāṃ ca virekādīnāmupakramāṇāṃ tatsādhyeṣvāmayeṣu sirāvyadhaḥ pradhānam |
amunā hi te samūlāḥ śoṣamāyānti kedārasetubhedena śālyādaya iva |
anyanna hi tathā dūṣyaṃ karmedaṃ prathamaṃ tataḥ ||

tatrāmbu śārīramāhārasārabhūtaṃ rasākhyamavikṛtamavikṛtena tejasā rañjitamindragopākāraṃ ca śaśaśoṇitaguñjāphalālaktapadmasuvarṇavarṇaṃ dhautaṃ ca virajyamānaṃ madhuramīṣallavaṇaṃ snigdhamasaṃhatamaśītoṣṇaṃ guru pittaikacayaprakopopaśamaṃ saumyāgneyaṃ prakṛtyā raktamāhuḥ |
ye ca śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyaiḥ sarvadoṣapratipakṣaiḥ samyagapyupakrāntāḥ sādhyā api na sidhyanti |
te ca raktaprakopajāḥ tasmātteṣvatyudriktaraktavisrāvaṇāya yathāsvaṃ sirāṃ vidhyet ||
na cāvyadhanīyāścāyantritānutthitāḥ sirāḥ na tiryaṅna cātiśītoṣṇavarṣavātābhreṣu |
tatra snehapītādiṣu samyagviddhā api sirā na sravantyatisravanti vā samyaksnigdhasvinnasya punardravībhūtā doṣāḥ śoṇitamanupraviṣṭāḥ samyak pracyavante |
śironetrarogeṣu lālāṭyāmupanāsyāmapāṅgyāṃ vā karṇarogeṣu paritaḥ karṇau |

atha kṛtasvastyayanamāturaṃ vyādhibalasātmyādyavekṣya snigdhaṃ jāṅgalarasaṃ yavāgūṃ vā pāyayitvā muhūrtamātramāśvāsitaṃ pūrvāhṇe 'parāhve vāṅgāratāpoṣṇabāṣpānyatareṇa svinnaṃ jānūcchrite mṛdāvāsane jānunihitakūrparaṃ samasthitapādaṃ pratyādityamupaveśayet |
tataścāyatena vastrāṅguṣṭhagarbheṇa muṣṭidvayenāturo yathāsvaṃ manye nipīḍayeddantaiśca dantān |
puruṣaścainaṃ pṛṣṭhata ūrdhvasthaḥ vastrakṛkāṭikāntaranyastayanvastraṃ prāṇānabādhamāno yantrayedityeṣo 'ntarmukhavarjyānāṃ sirāṇāṃ vyadhane yantravidhiḥ |
utthitāñca spandamānāṃ sparśadāṃ vābhilakṣya vāmahastena kuṭhārikāmūrdhvadaṇḍāṃ kṛtvā sirāmadhyenyasya lakṣayitvā ca tathaiva ca madhyamayāṅgulyā tāḍayedaṅguṣṭhodareṇa vā pīḍayet |
viśvācīgṛdhrasyoranākuñcite kūrpare jānuni ca sukhopaviṣṭasya gūḍhāṅguṣṭhabaddhamuṣṭervyadhanīyapradeśasyopari caturaṅgule plotādyanyatamena ca badhvā hastasirām |
evamekapādaṃ susaṃsthitaṃ sthāpayitvānyapādamīṣatsaṅkucitaṃ tasyopari nidhāya jānusandheradhohastābhyāmāgulphaṃ nipīḍya pūrvavadbadhvā pādasirāṃ vidhyet |
samyagviddhānāmapi ca sirāṇāmavahanakāraṇāni mūrchā bhayaṃ yantraśaithilyamatigāḍhatvamatyāśitatā kṣāmatvaṃ kuṇṭhaśastravyadho mūtritoccāritatvaṃ duḥsvinnatā kaphāvṛtavraṇadvāratā ceti |
yasya tu sravati rakte mūrchā jāyate tasya vimucya yantraṃ śītasalilārdrapāṇisparśena vyajanavāyunā śrotrasukhena vacasā ca samāśvāsayannupaśamayya mūrchāṃ punaḥ srāvayet |
tatra phenilamaruṇaṃ śyāvamacchaṃ rūkṣamaskandi kaṣāyānurasaṃ lohagandhi vegasrāvi śītaṃ ca raktaṃ vātāt |
gṛhadhūmāñjanodakakṛṣṇaṃ pītaṃ haritaṃ visraṃ matsyagandhi kaṭutvānmakṣikāniṣṭamauṣṇyādaskandi sacandrakaṃ gomūtrābhaṃ ca pittāt |
kovidārapuṣpagairikodakāpāṇḍu śītaṃ snigdhaṃ skandi ghanaṃ picchilaṃ tantumad vraṇadvārāvasādi lavaṇarasaṃ vasāgandhi ca kaphāt |
satailaṃ ca plotaṃ sirāmukhe datvā badhnīyāt |
atiṣṭhati tu rakte sirāmukhaṃ sandhātuṃ pūrvoktaiścūrṇairavacūrṇyāṅgulyagreṇa pīḍayet |
śālmalyupodakāpicchāṃ vā vraṇamukhe datvā gāḍhaṃ badhnīyāt |
padmakādikvāthaṃ śarkarāmadhumadhuraṃ kṣīramikṣurasameṇahariṇājorabhramahiṣavarāhāṇāmanyatamasya sirāṃ vidhvā rudhiramāmaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā pānaṃ dadyāt |
tatra dhyāmaṃ piṭakācitaṃ śophavedanāvantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ śoṇitāsrāviṇaṃ budbudavadudgataṃ mṛdumāṃsaṃ ca vraṇaṃ saśalyaṃ vidyāt ||
viśeṣatastu tvaggate śalye vivarṇaḥ śopho bhavatyāyataḥ kaṭhinaśca |
māṃsagate śophābhivṛddhiḥ śalyamārgānupasaṃrohaḥ pīḍanāsahiṣṇutā coṣaḥ pākaśca ||
dhamanīsthe saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchatyaṅgapīḍā hṛllāsaśca |
tatra tvakpranaṣṭe snigdhasvinnāyāṃ mṛnmāṣayavagodhūmagomayacūrṇamarditāyāṃ tvaci yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati |
karśitasya ca śithilībhūtamanavabaddhaṃ kṣubhyamānaṃ yatra yatra saṃrambhaṃ vedanāṃ vā janayati tatra śalyam ||
sirāsrotodhamanīsnāvapraṇaṣṭe khaṇḍacakramaśvayuktaṃ rathamāropyāturaṃ viṣame 'dhvani śīghraṃ nayet |
sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ tūcchritahastiskandhāśvamādrurohaṇadrutayānalaṅghanaplavanavyāyāmairjambhodgārakāsakṣavathuṣṭhīvanahasanaprāṇāyāmairmalaśukrotsargairvā yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati |
yatra vā svalpe 'pyāyāse svāpo gauravaṃ ghaṭṭanaṃ śopho vā syāttatra śalyamādiśet ||
pratilomamanuttuṇḍitaṃ chedanīyaṃ pṛthumukhaṃ ca śalyaṃ nirghātayet |
tathāpyaśakyaṃ śastreṇa viśasya tato nirlohitaṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvāgnighṛtamadhuprabhṛtibhiḥ svedayitvāvadahya tarpayitvā sarpirmadhubhyāṃ badhvācārikamādiśet |
aśakyamevaṃ vā balavadbhiḥ sugṛhītasya yantreṇa grāhayitvā śalyavāraṅgaṃ pratibhujya vā dhanurguṇairekato badhvānyataśca pañcāṅgyā susaṃyatasyāśvasya vaktrakaṭake badhnīyāt |
dṛḍhāṃ vā vṛkṣaśākhāmavanamya tamyāṃ pūrvavad badhvoddharet ||
nāḍīyantreṇa va bahumukhena yathāsvamupasaṅgṛhya śalākāyantreṇānyena vā pūrvavadāharet |
kaṇṭhasrotogate tu śalye bisaṃ saktaṃ sūtraṃ kaṇṭhe praveśayet |
atha tadgṛhītaṃ vijñāya śalyaṃ samameva sūtraṃ bisaṃ cākṣipet |
jātuṣe tu kaṇṭhasakte kaṇṭhe nāḍīṃ praveśayettadā cāgnitaptāṃ sūkṣmamukhīṃ śalākāmatha tāṃ gṛhītaśalyāṃ śītābhiradbhiḥ pariṣicya sthirībhūtāmāharet |
matsyakaṇṭakamanyadvā tādṛgasthiśalyaṃ kaṇṭhalagnaṃ sūtreṇa sūtraplotena vā veṣṭitayāṃgulyāpaharet |
tathā nirbhujya vartma vartmagatamapanīya coṣṇāmbubāṣpasvedaṃ samadhumadhukakvāthena sarpiṣā ca pariṣekaṃ kuryāt |
kīṭe karṇasrotaḥpraviṣṭe todo gauravaṃ bharabharāyamāṇaṃ ca bhavati spandamāne cāpyadhikaṃ vedanā |
tatra salavaṇenāmbunā madhukayuktena madyena vā sukhoṣṇena pūraṇam |
pārśvāvanataṃ vā kṛtvā hastenāhanyānnāḍyā vā cūṣayet |
śalyāni na viśīryante śarīre mṛnmayāni ca ||
śalye māṃsāvagāḍhe cet sa deśo na vidahyate |
alpe śophe ca tāpe ca niḥśalyamiti nirdiśet ||
śalye śalyaṃ śarādyaṃ tu viśeṣāttena cintyate ||
dvividhe hi vyādhāvupāyāpekṣe nija gāgantau vā bheṣajaviṣayātīte śastrakarma prayujyate ||
sa cāmayaḥ prāyeṇa śvayathupūrvako bhavatyataḥ śophāvasthasyaiva vātapittakapharaktasaṃsargasannipātātmakatāmupalakṣya pākabhayādyathāsvamupavāsalepasekāsṛṅmokṣakaṣāyaghṛtapānaśodhanāni prayuñjīta ||
tatra śophasyāmalakṣaṇamalpatā cālpoṣmarujatvaṃ tvaksavarṇatā sthairyaṃ ca ||

saṃrambhaśūlarāgadāhoṣārucitṛṣṇājvarāratisparśāsahatvānidratāsamanvito viṣyandayati sarpiḥ śoṣayati pradehaṃ sarṣapakalkopalipta iva cimicimāyate pipīlikābhiriva saṃsarpyate pīḍyata iva pāṇinā ghaṭyata ivāṅgulyā tāḍyata iva daṇḍena tudyata iva sūcībhirbhidyata iva śaktibhiśchidyata iva śastreṇa daśyata iva vṛścikairdahyata ivāgnikṣārābhyāṃ mathyata ivomulkena ||
pakve tu gatavegatvaṃ pramlānatā tvakśithilatā valīprādurbhāvaḥ pāṇḍutā madhyonnatatāṅgulyavapīḍitamukte pratyunnamanaṃ bastāvivodakasya pūyasya sañcaraṇaṃ kaṇḍūḥ saṃrambhaśūlādyupaśamaśca ||
kaphajeṣu tu śopheṣu keṣucit gambhīratvādraktameva vipacyate |
athainaṃ samyakpakvamavadhārya bhīruvṛddhabāladurbalaklībakṣīṇagarbhiṇīviṣārditaśastrakṣāmeṣu pākoddhatadoṣeṣu ca piṇḍiteṣu sandhimarmāśriteṣvalpeṣu vā śopheṣu tīkṣṇoṣṇadravyairdāraṇaṃ kurvīta |
prāk śastrādbhojayediṣṭaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ ca pāyayet |

athopahṛtayantraśastrakṣārāgnijāmbavauṣṭhapicuplotapatrasūtracarmapaṭṭamadhusnehakaṣāyālepakalkasekodakumbhaśītoṣṇodakakaṭāhavyajanādivraṇopayogisarvopakaraṇamāśritaśayanīyamupasthitasthirasnehabalavadavalambakapuruṣamiṣṭe 'hanimuhūrte ca dadhyakṣatānnapānarukmaratnārcitavipraṃ praṇateṣṭadevataṃ kṛtamaṅgalaṃ bhuktavantamāturaṃ prāṅmukhamupaveśya saṃveśya vā yantrayitvā pratyaṅmukho vaidyo marmasirāsnāyusandhyasthidhamanīḥ pariharannanulomaṃ śastraṃ nidadhyādāpūyadarśanāt |
dvyaṅgulāntaraṃ tryaṅgulāntaraṃ vābhisamīkṣya vivṛtte pradeśe vāmapradeśinyaiṣitvā nātivivṛtte gambhīramāṃsale caiṣaṇyā |
yato gatāṃ gatiṃ vidyādutsaṅgo yatra yatra ca |
tatra tatra vraṇaṃ kuryāt suvibhaktaṃ nirāśayam |
āyataṃ ca viśālaṃ ca yathā doṣo na tiṣṭhati ||
anyatra tu sirāsnāyūpaghāto 'tivedanā cirād vraṇasaṃroho māṃsaskandī ca tiryakchedāt bhavanti ||

tataḥ śastramavacārya śītābhiradbhirāturamāśvāsya samantāt pratipīḍyāṅgulyā vraṇamapi prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa vraṇāt plotenāmbho 'panīya vedanārakṣoghnairguggulvagarusarjarasavacāgaurasarṣapahiṅgulavaṇanimbapatraiḥ saghṛtairvraṇaṃ dhūpayitvā yathāsvamauṣadhena madhughṛtatilakalkaiśca digdhāṃ vatiṃ praṇidhāya kalkena pūrayitvā nātibhṛṣṭayavasaktubhirghṛtāktairbhājanānte 'mbhasā dakṣiṇāṅgulībhiḥ sumṛditairavacchādya ghanāṃ kabalikāṃ datvā savyadakṣiṇānyatarapārśve ṛjumanāviddhamasaṅkucitaṃ mṛdupaṭṭaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt ||
śastrakṣatarujāyāṃ tu pratatāyāṃ yaṣṭīmadhukasarpiṣoṣṇena vraṇaṃ siñcet |
udakumbhāccāpo gṛhītvā prokṣayan parito vikīrya parṇaśabaryādibhirasya rakṣāṃ kuryādrakṣo 'bhibhavaniṣedhārtham |

bhojayeccainaṃ yathāsātmyaṃ samātītaśāliṣaṣṭikayavagodhūmānyatamaṃ mudgamasūrāḍhakīsatīnayūṣajāṅgalarasopetaṃ jīvantīsuniṣaṇṇakataṇḍulīyakavāstukavārtākapaṭolakāravellakabālamūlaśaśākayuktaṃ dāḍimāmalakasaindhavasahitaṃ sarpiḥsnigdhaṃ laghvalpamuṣṇodakottaraṃ ca |
punaśca tṛtīye 'hani pakṣālanādi pūrvavat vraṇakarma kuryāt |
na ca vikeśikāmauṣadhaṃ vātisnigdharūkṣamatiślathamatigāḍhamaślakṣṇaṃ durnyastaṃ vā dadyāt |
vyamlaṃ tu pāṭitaṃ śophaṃ pācanaiḥ samupācaret |

yastu sīvyo vraṇastatra calāsthiśalyapāṃsutṛṇaromaśuṣkaraktādīnapohya vicchinnapravilambitaṃ māṃsaṃ sandhyasthīni ca yathāsthānaṃ samyak sthāpayitvā sthite rakte yathārhaṃ sūcyopahṛtena snāyusūtravālānyatamena sīvyet |
na cātisannikṛṣṭāṃ viprakṛṣṭāmatyalpabahugrāhiṇīṃ vā sūcīṃ pātayet |
asīvyā vaṅkṣaṇavakṣaḥkakṣādiṣu pracaleṣvalpamāṃseṣu ca vāyunirvāmiṇo 'ntarlohitaśalyā viṣāgnikṣārakṛtāśca vraṇāḥ ||
sīvyāstu medassamutthitā bhinnalikhitāḥ kaphagranthiralpapālikaḥ karṇaḥ sadyovraṇāśca |
yo yasmin pradeśe suniviṣṭo bhavati taṃ tasmin kurvīta |
na tu vraṇasyopari na cābādhakaro yathā syāt ||
bandhastviṣṭo 'nile duṣṭe duṣṭe bhagne vraṇeṣu ca |
kaphavāte ghano gāḍhaḥ pittarakte tanuḥ ślathaḥ ||
samo mṛduraruk śīghraṃ vraṇaḥ śudhyati rohati |
māṃsapāke na baddhavyā gudapāke ca dāruṇe |
arakṣayā vraṇe yasmin makṣikā nikṣipet krimīn |
pracchādya māṃsapeśyā vā vraṇaṃ tānāśu nirharet ||
utpadyamānāsu ca tāsu tāsvavasthāsu doṣādīnapekṣya yathāsvamupakramairupakramet ||
māsān ṣaṭ sapta vā nṛṛṇāṃ vidhireṣa praśasyate ||

kṣāro hi nānauṣadhasamavāyanirvṛtteḥ sarvarasādhiṣṭhānaṃ kaṭukalavaṇarasabhūyiṣṭhastīkṣṇoṣṇo dahanaḥ pācano vidāraṇo vilāyanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ krimyāmamedoviṣāpahaḥ sarvaśastrānuśastrāṇāṃ ca variṣṭhaḥ chedanabhedanapāṭanalekhanakaraṇādyataśca sambādhāvakāśajeṣu duḥkhāvacāraṇīyaśastreṣu nāsārśo 'rbudādiṣu śastreṇa cāsidhyastu duṣṭavraṇeṣu bahuśaḥ prakopiṣu prayujyate |

tasya pākavidhiḥ śaradi śucirupoṣitaḥ śuklavāsāḥ praśaste 'hani praśastadeśajātaṃ madhyamavayasamanupahataṃ mahāntaṃ kālamuṣkakaṃ surāpalalasumano 'kṣatādibhiścaturdiśaṃ baliṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ cābhyarcyainamadhivāsayet ||
vṛkṣaṃ na lobhānna krodhād brāhmaṇārthe viśeṣataḥ ||
athāparedyustatra yadyadbhutaṃ vaikṛtaṃ vā kiñcinna paśyettato yugamātramārūḍhe savitari brāhmaṇān vācayitvā taṃ pādapaṃ pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ vā pātayet |

evaṃ ca pāribhadrapalāśāśvakarṇarājavṛkṣamahāvṛkṣavṛkṣakendravṛkṣāsphotasaptacchadanaktamālatilvakakadalībibhītakāśvamārakapūtīkacitrakārkakākajaṅghāpāmārgāgnimanthān vasante saṅgṛhītāṃśca yavān saśūkanālāṃścatasraśca kośātakīḥ savān samūlaphalapatraśākhān khaṇḍaśaḥ kalpayitvā nātiśuṣkān śilātalasthān nivāte pṛthaṅ nicayīkṛtya muṣkakanicaye ca sudhāśarkarāḥ prakṣipya tilakuntalairādīpayet |
dagdhvā ca śānte 'gnau pṛthak sudhāśarkarābhasma kṛtvetarat sarvakṣāradroṇamadhikamuṣkakaṃ salilapalasahasreṇa gavādimūtrapalasahasreṇa cāloḍya mahatā vastreṇa parisrāvayet |
yāvadaccho raktastīkṣṇaḥ picchilaśca jātastadā taṃ kṣāraniṣyandaṃ gṛhītvā bhasma vivarjayet |
pacyamāne ca tasmiṃstāḥ sudhābhasmaśarkarāḥ kṣīrabakaṃ śaṅkhanābhicāyase pātre 'gnivarṇān kṛtvā tatkṣārācchakuḍavamātre nirvāpya tenaiva ca suślakṣṇaṃ piṣṭvā pratīvāpaṃ dadyāt |
tataśca sutarāṃ darvyāvaghaṭṭayan vipacet yāvacca sabāṣpairbudbudaiḥ samuttiṣṭhet sāndratayā ca darvīpralepī syāttadainamavatāryāyoghaṭe yavaraśau suguptaṃ sthāpayet |
tīkṣṇe tu dantīcitrakalāṅgalikāpūtīkapravālatālapatrībiḍasvarjikākanakakṣīrīhiṅguvacātiviṣāḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇīkṛtā dagdhāśca śaṅkhaśuktīḥ pūrvavat prativāpaṃ dadyāt |
tatranātitīkṣṇo nātimṛduḥ śvetaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ śīghraḥ picchilaḥ śikharī sukhanirvāpyo 'lparuganabhiṣyandī ceti daśa kṣārasya guṇāḥ |
atha kṣārārhasyopaviṣṭasya saṃviṣṭasya vāptaparicārakagṛhītasya vyādhiṃ chitvāvalikhya pracchāya vā picuplotānyatarāvaguṇṭhitayā śalākayā kṣāraṃ pātayet |
vartmaroge tu nirbhujya vartmanī picunā madhūcchiṣṭena vā kṛṣṇabhāgaṃ pracchādya padmapatratanuḥ kṣāralepaḥ |
tataḥ pramārjanena pramṛjya kṣāraṃ samyagdagdhamavekṣya nirvāpayetsarpirmadhubhyāṃ śuktatuṣodakamastukṣīrādibhiśca |
sthiramūlatvāttu yadi kṣāradagdhaṃ na viśīryate tato dhānyāmlabījamadhuyaṣṭikāyuktaistilairālepayetsuvarṇakṣīrīyutairvā trivṛdviḍaṅgasāravadbhirvā |
eṣāmeva ca kalkakvāthe siddhaṃ sarpistailaṃ vā ropaṇam |
gude viṇmūtrarodho 'tīsāraḥ puṃstvopaghāto gudavidaraṇācca mṛtyurvā sarvadā vā śophatodavedanāsrāvāḥ |
saguḍaṃ vā dadhisaraṃ tailaṃ vā sasitopalam ||
kṣāro nivartate tena prasādaṃ tvak ca gacchati ||
tatrāgnikarma tvaci māṃse sirāsnāyusandhyasthiṣu ca prayujyate |
na tu dahedbhinnakoṣṭhamantaśśoṇitamanuddhṛtaśalyamanekavraṇapīḍitamuṣṇe ca kāle tathā kṣārānarhaṃ ca ātyayike tu vyādhau kṛtoṣṇapratīkārasya picchilamannamaśitavato 'gnikarma kuryāt ||

atha dāhārhamāturaṃ kṛtasvastyayanamupahṛtasarvopakaraṇaṃ prākśiraḥsaṃviṣṭamāptāvalambitaṃ kṛtvā vaidyo nirdhūmabṛhatsthiradīptakhadirabadarādyaṅgārairayoghaṭanaprakāreṇa bhastrānilādhmātairvyajanena cordhvānirgacchajjvālatayāpāditāpadyamānabhāsurāgnivarṇairjāmbavauṣṭhādibhirvyādhipradeśavaśādvalayārdhacandasvastikāṣṭāpadabindurekhāpratisāraṇavikalpena muhurmuhurhitopahitābhirvāgbhiradbhiścāturamāśvāsayan dahedā samyagdāhaliṅgotpatteḥ |
samyagdagdhaliṅgaṃ punassaśabdaṃ dahanaṃ durgandhitvaṃ tvaksaṅkocaśca tvagdagdhe |
kṛṣṇonnatavraṇatvaṃ sthite ca rakte lasīkāsrutiḥ sirādagdhe |
atidagdhe tūgrarujatā dhūmāyanaṃ māṃsāvalambanaṃ sirādivyāpado gambhīravraṇatā jvaradāhatṛṇmūrchācchardayaḥ śoṇitātipravṛttistannimittāścopadavāḥ kṛcchreṇa rohaṇaṃ rūḍhe ca vivarṇateti |
styāne rakte himairnoṣmā niṣkrāmati yato bahiḥ ||
vedanā vardhate tena rudhiraṃ ca vidahyate |
śītāmuṣṇāṃ ca durdagdhe kriyāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ punaḥ |
snehadagdhe bhṛśataraṃ rūkṣaṃ tatra tu yojayet |
atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ ||
